# May Institute Essentials 2026

> May Institute Essentials is a condensed, fully virtual version of the May
> Institute, covering computation and statistics for mass spectrometry-based
> proteomics. It runs November 2-6, 2026, online. Sessions are led by the
> developers of the methods and software they teach.

Site: https://vitek-lab.github.io/MIe-2026/

## Program at a glance

- Dates: November 2-6, 2026 (Monday through Friday)
- Time: 10:00 a.m. - 12:30 p.m. EST each day (7:00-9:30 a.m. PST, 4:00-6:30 p.m. CET)
- Format: fully online; five sessions, one per day
- Audience: early career researchers and established scientists in experimental
  or computational proteomics
- Cost: $50 academic, non-profit, and governmental; $100 commercial. A single
  fee covers the full week.
- Registration: open. Register at https://commerce.cashnet.com/SFMI
  (Northeastern University payment portal), linked from
  https://vitek-lab.github.io/MIe-2026/#register
- Contact: mayinstitute@northeastern.edu
- Host: May Institute, Barnett Institute and Khoury College of Computer
  Sciences, Northeastern University

Registration includes access to all sessions, interactive discussion with
presenters, 1:1 office hours with the tool developers, presentation materials
(slides, code, datasets), and early access to recordings.

## Courses and sessions

The week has five session days, each with its own page: three MSstats days
(November 2-4) followed by two Cardinal days (November 5-6). Day numbers below
are counted within each course, so Cardinal Day 1 is the fourth day of the week.

### MSstats (November 2-4, 2026)

Statistical analysis of quantitative MS-based proteomic experiments with
MSstats: normalization, missing value imputation, summarization of protein
abundances, confidence intervals for fold changes, testing for differential
abundance, and multivariate analysis for biomarker discovery. Assumes some
prior experience with statistics and proteomics.

- [MSstats Day 1: Differential analysis of label-free proteomics experiments](https://vitek-lab.github.io/MIe-2026/msstats-day-1.html):
  Monday, November 2, 2026. Taught by Devon Kohler, Sarah Szvetecz, and Tony Wu.
  Session topics to be announced.
- [MSstats Day 2: PTMs and chemoproteomics](https://vitek-lab.github.io/MIe-2026/msstats-day-2.html):
  Tuesday, November 3, 2026. Taught by Devon Kohler, Sarah Szvetecz, and Tony
  Wu. Session topics to be announced.
- [MSstats Day 3: Interpretation with MSstatsBioNet and INDRA](https://vitek-lab.github.io/MIe-2026/msstats-day-3.html):
  Wednesday, November 4, 2026. Taught by Tony Wu and Benjamin Gyori. The INDRA
  system, the INDRA Database, Network Search tool, and Biomedical Discovery
  Engine, then MSstatsBioNet for building experiment-specific biological
  subnetworks from statistical results. Run through web interfaces, primarily
  the INDRA Biomedical Discovery Engine at https://discovery.indra.bio; the
  page also has optional instructions for installing INDRA
  (https://www.indra.bio) locally.

### Cardinal (November 5-6, 2026)

Data manipulation, visualization, and statistical analysis of mass spectrometry
imaging (MSI) experiments using Cardinal and R. Taught by Kylie Bemis, Sai
Srikanth Lakkimsetty, Ethan Rogers, and Yinyue Zhu. Assumes basic familiarity
with R.

- [Cardinal Day 1: Introduction to Cardinal, preprocessing, and visualization](https://vitek-lab.github.io/MIe-2026/cardinal-day-1.html):
  Thursday, November 5, 2026. Cardinal data structures and the .imzML format,
  larger-than-memory datasets, preprocessing (recalibration, peak picking, peak
  alignment, normalization), and visualization of spectra and ion images.
- [Cardinal Day 2: Case studies on statistics and machine learning with MSI data](https://vitek-lab.github.io/MIe-2026/cardinal-day-2.html):
  Friday, November 6, 2026. Region of interest discovery with univariate and
  multivariate segmentation, then a case study of differential abundance
  between ROIs and experimental conditions.

## Pages

- [Home](https://vitek-lab.github.io/MIe-2026/): overview, full schedule, cost, sponsors
- One page per session day, listed under Courses and sessions above. Each
  carries that day's topic and schedule alongside the course background,
  audience, installation instructions, materials, and links.
- [Instructors](https://vitek-lab.github.io/MIe-2026/instructors.html): instructor
  biographies for both courses, plus organizers
- [Technical details](https://vitek-lab.github.io/MIe-2026/details.html): format,
  office hours, software prerequisites, recordings
